passage:
At West Junior High, the lunch bell rings at 12:00. Students usually rush out of classrooms as soon as they hear it.
One day, the bell did not ring. Teachers forgot to check the clock, and many classes kept studying. Ten minutes later, students began to look confused.
When the mistake was discovered, everyone laughed. Some students said it was the quietest lunch start ever.
The principal later asked, "Why do we wait for a bell to tell us we are hungry"
He was joking, but some students thought about it. They realized that bells, alarms, and phones controlled many parts of their day.
The lunch bell returned the next day, but a few students started wearing watches.
